result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional, but a few visual issues stand out: horizontal content is clipped at the right edge (category chips and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards), and a '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card is a content/logic error that looks broken.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) reads '-0%', which is a meaningless/discount logic error and looks visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Either show a real discount percentage (e.g. '-20%') or hide the badge entirely when the discount is 0%.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') and its delivery price are cut off at the right screen edge with no visible scroll affordance or padding.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a peek/scroll indicator so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, and ensure card text isn't awkwardly truncated.

issues.description: The category filter chip row ('Healthy' and the next chip) is clipped at the right edge without a fade or scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Add a gradient fade or partial next-chip peek to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The notification bell icon relies on a small red dot with no text or badge count, which may be unclear to some users.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessible label (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread') and consider a count badge.
